gas_can.name: Full gas can (5 gal)
gas_can.desc: Poured in automatically before you run dry.

spare_tire.name: Spare tire
spare_tire.helps: Saves a day on a flat.
spare_tire.desc: Only slightly balder than the ones you have.

jumper_cables.name: Jumper cables
jumper_cables.desc: Red to red. Cousin Dwayne is not allowed to touch them.

first_aid.name: First-aid kit
first_aid.desc: Bandages, tweezers, and the good antacids.

ammo.name: Box of ammo (10 rounds)
ammo.desc: For poaching. Not that you said that out loud.

road_atlas.name: Paper road atlas
road_atlas.desc: Overrules the GPS. Never folds back up.

bear_spray.name: Bear spray
bear_spray.desc: Not a body spray. Ask Dwayne how he knows.

banjo.name: Pawn shop banjo
banjo.desc: Has three strings and a history.

hay_sack.name: Sack of hay (8 lb)
hay_sack.desc: Fed to her before she runs out.

horseshoes.name: Spare horseshoes
horseshoes.helps: Saves a day on a thrown shoe.
horseshoes.desc: Lucky, if you nail them on the right way up.

pendleton.name: Vintage wool blanket
pendleton.helps: For the condo: adds 300 to your score.
pendleton.desc: Smells like 1962 and one specific horse.

rotary.name: Rotary telephone
rotary.helps: For the condo: adds 90 to your score.
rotary.desc: Does not work. Priced as if it does.

chandelier.name: Antler chandelier
chandelier.helps: For the condo: adds 650 to your score.
chandelier.desc: Many elk shed to make this possible.

saddle.name: Hand-tooled saddle for the wall
saddle.helps: For the condo: adds 800 to your score.
saddle.desc: Will never meet a horse again.

jukebox.name: 1950s jukebox
jukebox.helps: For the condo: adds 1300 to your score.
jukebox.desc: Plays one song. It is perfect.
